d:
The next-generation Porsche 718 is going electric, but can an EV still deliver the feel of a proper mid-engine sports car? We get behind the wheel of the Porsche 983, the electric successor to the 718 Boxster and Cayman.
With a mid-engine-inspired layout, rear-wheel drive, playful handling and Porsche's E-Shift technology that simulates gear changes and engine sound, this electric sports car is designed to make driving feel more involving than a conventional EV.
